name: singlet_normalization_depth_confounding_diagnostic
title: Residual depth-confounding diagnostic
description: Tests whether a normalised matrix still carries sequencing-depth or detection-rate structure, per gene and per principal component, within strata and against a calibrated null. Depth and detection covariates are computed from raw counts, so the matrix under test cannot alter them. The default method pc_r2 accepts any matrix; nb_lrt needs raw counts and uses obs/size_factor as offset when present, otherwise library size. It writes var/depth_r2, var/depth_flag and uns/depth_diagnostic and never modifies expression; do not use it alone to choose a normalisation, or on depth recomputed from normalised values.

dataset.description: Dataset handle: a .singlet path or URI (local path, s3://, r2://, https://) or a workspace handle.

counts_layer.description: Raw count layer from which depth and detection covariates are computed.

normalized_layer.description: Normalised matrix to diagnose: X or the name of a layer.

method.description: pc_r2: stratified PC R-squared for any matrix; nb_lrt: per-gene negative-binomial test on counts; pipecomp_gene_cor: pipeComp-style per-gene correlation.

stratify_by.description: obs column defining strata, for example cell type; null treats all cells as one stratum.

n_pcs.description: Number of principal components of the matrix under test to evaluate.

null_method.description: beta: closed-form null; permutation: depth and detection shuffled within strata, calibrated.

n_permutations.description: Permutation draws for the within-stratum null.

spline_df.description: Spline basis columns per covariate; 1 means linear.

null_method.description: chi_square: asymptotic likelihood-ratio test; permutation: within-stratum shuffles.

n_permutations.description: Permutation draws, used only when null_method is permutation.

fdr_threshold.description: Benjamini-Hochberg threshold for flagging depth-associated genes.

min_cells_per_gene.description: Minimum detected cells for a gene to be tested.

device.description: Execution device; auto picks CUDA when a device with enough memory is available.

seed.description: Random seed for permutation nulls; a fixed seed gives identical results.

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, memory and device without running.

overwrite.description: Replace existing output members instead of failing.

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: ran inline and wrote members; dry_run: only an estimate was computed; queued: running as a long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written, e.g. var/depth_flag. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: For completed runs: method, n_strata, score, n_components, null_method, n_permutations, p_value, n_flagged_genes. Never raw matrices.

provenance_id.description: Id of the provenance record appended to the dataset (null unless completed).

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device.
